tools.name: get_latest_sdk_version
tools.description: Resolves latest published Storyly Placement SDK version for Android or iOS.

tools.name: get_feature_guide
tools.description: Returns a feature-first guide with checklist, resources, and shared canonical APIs.

featureId.description: Guide key or synonym (e.g., 'shoppable-content', 'cart', 'deep links'). Resolved against the live docs index; if unknown, use 'query'.

query.description: Free-text feature query when featureId is unknown.

tools.name: get_api_reference
tools.description: Returns live API reference (signatures + doc links from integration.storyly.io) for a symbol, and the features that use it. Accepts a symbol name or free-text query.

apiId.description: Symbol name (e.g., 'STRPlacementView', 'STRProductItem') or a dotted member (e.g., 'STRPlacementDataProvider.hydrateProducts').

query.description: Free-text query if the symbol name is not known.

platform.description: Scope the answer to a platform: 'android', 'ios', or 'web'. Omit to see every platform the symbol is documented on.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Searches feature guides and API references.

query.description: Search query across features and APIs.

platform.description: Preferred platform context for ranking results.

tools.name: get_release_notes
tools.description: Returns Storyly Placement SDK release notes (changelog) for Android, iOS, React Native, Flutter, or Web. Use 'sinceVersion' to see what changed after the version currently integrated (e.g. to check whether a feature exists in a newer release), 'version' for one release, or neither for the most recent entries.

platform.description: Platform: 'android', 'ios', 'reactnative', 'flutter', or 'web' (each has its own release notes).

sinceVersion.description: Return everything released AFTER this version — the upgrade gap from the version currently integrated (e.g. '1.5.0'). Use this to check whether a feature exists in a newer release.

limit.description: Max entries when neither 'version' nor 'sinceVersion' is given.
